title: X-LAB RS9 official specification recheck
notes: Rendered in a browser on 2026-10-27: the official page still describes RS9 as an all-round road bike using T1100 carbon and states 7 kg without pedals in size L, Maxxis HYPR ZK 700×28C tires, a 700C×25/32C inner tube and a 100 kg maximum load. It publishes no maximum tire clearance; the inner-tube size range is not a frame clearance statement.
